entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was seated on the Sila Orica in t..."
entries.dialogueText: I was seated on the Sila Orica in the Grand Hall. My court had gathered for the 'Hearing of Petitions'.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "This ceremony was a remnant from ol..."
entries.dialogueText: This ceremony was a remnant from olden times, even going back to the days of the first Toras, Henricus.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Five goblets were placed on a table..."
entries.dialogueText: Five goblets were placed on a table, each decorated with a different ornament according to the seat it represented. A petitioner would drop a small object of personal importance in the goblet.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I personally found it extremely old..."
entries.dialogueText: I personally found it extremely old-fashioned and banal. I walked to the center of the Throne Room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Whether or not I cared for it didn'..."
entries.dialogueText: Whether or not I cared for it didn't matter. The rules were the rules. I walked to the center of the Throne Room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A centuries-old crucible filled wit..."
entries.dialogueText: A centuries-old crucible filled with molten gold was brought in.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I looked inside the goblet ornament..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked inside the goblet ornamented with a crown.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I looked inside the goblet ornament..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked inside the goblet ornamented with a coin.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I looked inside the goblet ornament..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked inside the goblet ornamented with a sword.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I looked inside the goblet ornament..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked inside the goblet ornamented with a quill.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I ended the Hearing of Petitions."
entries.dialogueText: I ended the Hearing of Petitions.

entries.dialogueText: I took my place in the circle as part of the ceremony. I was the only one standing at the center.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I proclaim the end of the Hearing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I proclaim the end of the Hearing of Petitions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""When it comes time for the next co..."
entries.dialogueText: "When it comes time for the next council reshuffle, do not trouble me with such weak petitions."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It was promising but unfortunately..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was promising but unfortunately it only stayed that way."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The nobles left the Throne Room in..."
entries.dialogueText: The nobles left the Throne Room in silence, perhaps a bit disappointed by the lack of a show.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Suddenly I was the only one left in..."
entries.dialogueText: Suddenly I was the only one left in the huge room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Golden knives were handed to all of..."
entries.dialogueText: Golden knives were handed to all of us.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I cut my hand and spilled the blood..."
entries.dialogueText: I cut my hand and spilled the blood into the molten gold.
entries.menuText: Cut your hand and spill the blood into the molten gold.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My newest council member followed s..."
entries.dialogueText: My newest council member followed suit.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The others followed suit and mixed..."
entries.dialogueText: The others followed suit and mixed in their blood.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I pulled the lever to cast the molt..."
entries.dialogueText: I pulled the lever to cast the molten gold into necklaces.
entries.menuText: Pull the lever to cast the molten gold into necklaces.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "An odd smell filled the room as the..."
entries.dialogueText: An odd smell filled the room as the gold, mementos and blood mingled.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I watched the gold slowly sizzle..."
entries.dialogueText: As I watched the gold slowly sizzle and cool down, I contemplated what I had done.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The pain in my hand pulled me from..."
entries.dialogueText: The pain in my hand pulled me from my thoughts. A medic rushed over to tend to the cut.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for attending.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for attending."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""We have so much we can do together..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have so much we can do together. I can help you, as I helped your father."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""As your Grand Vizier, I will do wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "As your Grand Vizier, I will do whatever I can to guide you through the darkness with the light of God."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""There are many in Rizia that would..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are many in Rizia that would rejoice to see a man of faith ascend to such an important post."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Such believers can be... utilized..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such believers can be... utilized to aid the goals of the crown. I pray you will make the right choice."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Before my exile, I was one of the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before my exile, I was one of the most educated noblewomen in Brenas. On Caleqabiz, I spent much of my time reading about the principles of governance."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""Appoint me as Vizier and you can e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Appoint me as Vizier and you can expect both complete honesty and undying loyalty. Remember, I turned my own husband over to your father."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""That is what I can offer to you an..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is what I can offer to you and to the crown. Nothing more, nothing less."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I ask you: What better action to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ask you: What better action to signify the friendship between Rizians and Palesians?"

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""This is the logical choice, and I..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is the logical choice, and I think you know it."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""If you make me your Grand Vizier,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you make me your Grand Vizier, I assure you that it will guarantee the trust of Palesians and along with it, the international community..."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I am also a capable politician and..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am also a capable politician and a ruthless negotiator, as you have experienced firsthand. I can provide you with contacts that nobody else can."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""What better move to stir the heart..."
entries.dialogueText: "What better move to stir the hearts of your people? Romus, the Great Unifier! Your name will be written down in history."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""That is my pitch, if you will, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is my pitch, if you will, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You know very well what I am capab..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know very well what I am capable of, cousin."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I know how to wage war. I know how..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know how to wage war. I know how to maintain security. It sounds like I fill both of the roles required from this post."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You already know the great work I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "You already know the great work I've done as Chief of Police here in Porte Drazon. No need to delve further into that."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But that is not my only merit, as..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that is not my only merit, as you know. Hire me, and the Crown will have Rizia's largest and most passionate civilian security force at its fingertips."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""My father may be good, but I assur..."
entries.dialogueText: "My father may be good, but I assure you, I am better."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""As a Toras, I also think it is goo..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a Toras, I also think it is good to keep things in the family."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""All my life I have fought for this..."
entries.dialogueText: "All my life I have fought for this country. I bled for it. I went through hell for it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I know the ins and outs of our cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know the ins and outs of our country's military structure. More importantly, I command the respect of the Rizian Armed Forces and House Azaro."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I know every single one of our Gen..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know every single one of our General Staff because I trained them. I fought alongside them."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""War will come to Rizia someday, si..."
entries.dialogueText: "War will come to Rizia someday, sire. And to protect the interests of my proud kingdom, I am ready to die a thousand deaths."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My daughter is ready to step aside..."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter is ready to step aside. She has another role to play now."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I protected you and your father fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I protected you and your father for many years as part of the Golden Guard, and hopefully I will do so for many more."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""My entire life, I always felt that..."
entries.dialogueText: "My entire life, I always felt that in order to do my job better, I needed more and more of a say in matters."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I want to be elevated to a positio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to be elevated to a position that will allow me to have that say."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Trust in me and the Golden Guard,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Trust in me and the Golden Guard, and security will never be a worry in Rizia again."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""If I cannot serve you in the House..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I cannot serve you in the House of Delegates, then the Royal Council will have to do."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She smiled with uncharacteristic wa..."
entries.dialogueText: She smiled with uncharacteristic warmth.

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""I and my family still have conside..."
entries.dialogueText: "I and my family still have considerable influence in international investment circles, and I have accumulated numerous contacts that might be of use to us."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Treasurer of Rizia is a position t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Treasurer of Rizia is a position that requires more than mere number-crunching. One needs considerable political finesse."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""That's right. I want this job so m..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's right. I want this job so much I'm willing to go through *all* the formalities. I even bought a new tie."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""We got almost half of RRG back int..."
entries.dialogueText: "We got almost half of RRG back into the Royal Family's well-manicured hands."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Just look at how much gold we're h..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just look at how much gold we're hauling out of the ground right now. All thanks to me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""All apologies to the old gal Werne..."
entries.dialogueText: "All apologies to the old gal Werner, but you'd be doing her a favor by sending her off to an early retirement. The Treasury needs some fresh blood."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Not to make a big deal about it, Y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not to make a big deal about it, Your Majesty, but you did promise me this a while back. I hope those weren't just empty words."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Father. I know you still see me as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father. I know you still see me as your little girl. Maybe you don't think that I'm ready."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""But I have been on your council fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I have been on your council for some time now. I understand its intricacies very well."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Laurento has been like a grandfath..."
entries.dialogueText: "Laurento has been like a grandfather to me, but he's past his prime and you know it. It's time for the younger generation to represent Rizia on the global stage."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""As for me... well, you know better..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for me... well, you know better than anybody that work is all I have."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""We have had our differences. But p..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have had our differences. But please. Grant me this."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The ritual had finally ended."
entries.dialogueText: The ritual had finally ended.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I looked at the bright red, sizzlin..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked at the bright red, sizzling molten gold until my eyes began to water.

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I do not only ask this of you as t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not only ask this of you as the mother of the Prince Consort."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""By reinstating me as Duchess of Br..."
entries.dialogueText: "By reinstating me as Duchess of Brenas, you showed deep faith in my capabilities and in my noble house."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""By bringing me back from exile, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "By bringing me back from exile, you showed that House Toras was ready to place its faith in House Sazon once more."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I can think of no better way to re..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can think of no better way to return that gesture of faith than to serve on your council."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""You already trusted my judgement o..."
entries.dialogueText: "You already trusted my judgement once, when you cancelled the ill-advised reforms you were planning."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""I know you hunger for change. I ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you hunger for change. I can help you achieve your goals while keeping the nobility satisfied."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""And I am still prepared to keep th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am still prepared to keep the more... unruly elements of my house in line."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I realize that it's rather unortho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I realize that it's rather unorthodox to serve as the principal advisor to one's father-in-law. Rest assured that my own interests will come second to those of the Toras royal family. Every time."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""I realize that it's rather unortho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I realize that it's rather unorthodox to serve as the principal advisor to a man nearly twice my age. Rest assured that my own interests will come second to yours. Every time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I reject all of your petitions. Hu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I reject all of your petitions. Hugo Toras will remain my Grand Vizier."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Respectfully, after deposing me an..."
entries.dialogueText: "Respectfully, after deposing me and shooting my dog... this is the least you can do."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Respectfully, after deposing me as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Respectfully, after deposing me as Duke of Iza... this is the least you can do."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Not that I even need to do so, in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not that I even need to do so, in my opinion. Despite my temporary leave of absence and current physical disability, I am more than capable of resuming my previous role."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""An Azaro belongs in this role. You..."
entries.dialogueText: "An Azaro belongs in this role. You know it. I know it."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""My daughter will be disappointed...."
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter will be disappointed. But she will fill the role once more when she is ready."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I trust you to make the right deci..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust you to make the right decision."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Do not forget that it was only wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not forget that it was only with my help that the second and final Pales War was won."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Just as Duchess Azaro failed you,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as Duchess Azaro failed you, so will her father. I guarantee you that."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You trusted House Azaro, and they..."
entries.dialogueText: "You trusted House Azaro, and they guided you into an unwinnable war. I swear that would never have happened under my watch."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Do not forget how my skills served..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not forget how my skills served you in getting to the bottom of the Zille incident."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I also ask you to remember certain..."
entries.dialogueText: "I also ask you to remember certain other tasks I have performed for you. Loyally and without question."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Think about how much the Golden Gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about how much the Golden Guard has helped you accomplish thus far."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I reject the petitions. Titus Gord..."
entries.dialogueText: "I reject the petitions. Titus Gordion will remain my War and Security Councillor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I reject the petitions. Taddeus Az..."
entries.dialogueText: "I reject the petitions. Taddeus Azaro will remain my War and Security Councillor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I reject the petitions. The role o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I reject the petitions. The role of War and Security Councillor will remain empty."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Appoint me, and I promise I will r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Appoint me, and I promise I will restore Rizia's budget surplus back to its former glory."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""The same skills you saw me display..."
entries.dialogueText: "The same skills you saw me display as House Speaker, I would bring to bear as your councilor."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Coming out of the MITZ with nothin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Coming out of the MITZ with nothing? I never would have allowed that to happen."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""Coming away from the Aureus disput..."
entries.dialogueText: "Coming away from the Aureus dispute with nothing? I never would have allowed that to happen."

entries.speaker: Daria de Rava
entries.title: Daria de Rava: ""That will be all from me.""
entries.dialogueText: "That will be all from me."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""You gave me and my company more co..."
entries.dialogueText: "You gave me and my company more control over Rizia's gold industry than at any point in history. That's got to mean something."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He leaned forward."
entries.dialogueText: He leaned forward.

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You trusted me enough to send me t..."
entries.dialogueText: "You trusted me enough to send me to Pales."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""As for me... children are still a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As for me... children are still a ways in the future. And Manus and I won't be raising them without help, anyway."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""You already know how well you and..."
entries.dialogueText: "You already know how well you and I work together. Please, grant me this."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Finally, I will remind you that I'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Finally, I will remind you that I'm no longer your successor. Unless something happens to {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}, I'll never be Queen."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""If I cannot follow in the footstep..."
entries.dialogueText: "If I cannot follow in the footsteps of Lyza the Great, at least grant me this."

entries.speaker: Angelica Sazon
entries.title: Angelica Sazon: ""And I am still prepared to keep th..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I am still prepared to keep the more... unruly elements of my house in line. Including those who are upset that the Sazons no longer control Zille."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""As I'm no longer in line to become..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I'm no longer in line to become King Consort... I hope you will consider granting me this as a consolation prize."

entries.speaker: Sal Ignacius
entries.title: Sal Ignacius: ""Remember our conversation in Benie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember our conversation in Benievon, Your Majesty. Place your trust in me, and the blessings will be infinite."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""Pales is not our only enemy. More..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pales is not our only enemy. More war will come to this kingdom. And to protect my Rizia, I am ready to die a thousand times over."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Look. We've been through a lot, yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look. We've been through a lot, you and I."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""Look. I know I might not be the mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Look. I know I might not be the most natural choice for the Royal Council. But think about it for a minute."

entries.speaker: Russello Montoro
entries.title: Russello Montoro: ""I shouldn't even have to mention t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shouldn't even have to mention the various and sundry favors I've done for you..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She looked up at me. Her eyes were..."
entries.dialogueText: She looked up at me. Her eyes were moist.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""But that is not my only merit. Hir..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that is not my only merit. Hire me, and the Crown will finally be able to make use of Rizia's largest and most passionate civilian security force."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Also, naming me to your council me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Also, naming me to your council means I'll get to work with... well, you'll see."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""Also, naming me to your council me..."
entries.dialogueText: "Also, naming me to your council means I'll get to work with my wife! Ruling Rizia will truly be a family affair."

entries.speaker: Axel Reinhart
entries.title: Axel Reinhart: ""You rejected my wife's petition......"
entries.dialogueText: "You rejected my wife's petition... you owe it to us both to at least consider mine."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered his voice."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered his voice.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I know about the Queen Consort's b..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know about the Queen Consort's big plans for Rizia. Are you really going to let House Azaro have that much power over the Kingdom's fate?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You need a Toras to keep them in c..."
entries.dialogueText: "You need a Toras to keep them in check. I'm your man."

entries.speaker: Taddeus Azaro
entries.title: Taddeus Azaro: ""I have spoken with Lucita about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have spoken with Lucita about the great changes that are coming. You're going to need my involvement to make Ana Azaro's vision a reality."
